research_question: Can the strongest inherited full-native J-Space vector-control candidate bypass successor evidence gates even when scientific/owner/modular fields fail closed correctly?

v7.prepatch_behavior: The verdict spreads **base, recomputes scientific/owner/modular using case-bound factorial evidence, but does not overwrite full_native_jspace_vector_control_candidate.
v7.fail_open_case: An inherited v6 full-native TRUE can survive a modularity-v2 or semantic-factorial evidence failure.

v8.prepatch_behavior: The verdict spreads **base, recomputes scientific/owner/modular using preregistration-runtime binding, but does not overwrite full_native_jspace_vector_control_candidate.

counterhypothesis.claim: Full-native is intentionally orthogonal to successor evidence gates and may remain TRUE when modularity, factorial or preregistration-runtime binding fails.
counterhypothesis.reason: Current v7/v8 descriptions define positive successor status as requiring the added evidence boundaries; allowing the strongest inherited candidate alone to bypass them contradicts fail-closed successor semantics and the current Forschungsrun-1 full-control boundary.
